name: Boys & Girls Club of Central Illinois

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.15: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK only. 
Observed food handler begin to wash hands in the 3 part sink. Food handler was stopped and coached. Food handler then properly washed hands in the hand sink.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 
A bag of multiple bags of napkins is observed on the floor of the cafeteria. The napkins were moved up off of the floor. Store single use items protected from potential contamination.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-501.110: (A) Dressing rooms shall be used by EMPLOYEES if the EMPLOYEES regularly change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEE clothing and other possessions. 
Employee lunch box and other personal items are observed in the 2 door cooler with snacks and pints of milk used for the children. Provide a separate lower area for employee food and belongings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Racks in stainless steel refrigerator appear to have mold/debris deposits. Ensure racks are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent soil accumulation.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.
Mr. Joiner is a manager certified person.  Please provide a copy of his manager.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19  (C) Nonfood-contact surfaces of chest freezer has encrusted ice and is no longer easily cleanable. Defrost the freezer so that it is corrosion-resistant, nonabsorbent and smooth material meeting National Sanitation Foundation/ANSI certification for use within a foodservice facility.  Reference 4-101.19.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Chlorine test kit was not available for checking concentration of bleach solutions. Test kit provided (inspector had spare set).
Employee was advised on locations where test kits may be purchased (see general comments).

Use test strips to verify proper concentration of solutions in spray bottles used to wipe counters and tables (100-200ppm chlorine) and to make sure sanitizing solution is at proper concentration during ware washing (50-100ppm chlorine).

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text:
750.880 - A) Styrofoam cups were observed unwrapped in a box in the back hallway (~6 to 7 total). Cups were discarded.

B) Sleeve of Styrofoam cups next to popcorn machine were open on one end and sitting so the food contact surface of the cup at the open end was exposed to the air. Packaging was repositioned to cover the food contact surface of the cup.

Single service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1060 - One faucet in men's room does not have a cold water handle. Provide proper repairs so cold water is available at the handsink.

All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.
